If you are interested in network security and how traffic flows across a system, there are many ethical and legal ways to explore these concepts.Ethical Alternatives for LearningIf your goal is to understand network protocols or secure your own systems, I recommend looking into the following industry-standard tools:Wireshark: The world’s foremost network protocol analyzer. It allows you to see what’s happening on your network at a microscopic level for troubleshooting and educational purposes.OWASP ZAP / Burp Suite: These are "Interception Proxies" used by security professionals to test the security of their own web applications. If you're looking to build a career in this field, I suggest looking into Cybersecurity Certifications like the CompTIA Security+ or pursuing labs on platforms like TryHackMe or Hack The Box, which provide legal, sandboxed environments for learning these techniques.
